name: Tiha Avala
description: Ti si audio inžinjer Kluboslavija turneje. Pronađi slatku tačku zvuka — da publika bude srećna, a komšije ne zovu inspekciju. 6 nivoa, Avala teren, countdown do 20. juna.

modules.src/config.js: Sve konstante: TERRAIN_MOD, LEVEL_DATA ref, SCORE formule, SPL thresholds
modules.src/state.js: Game state (slider values, sim state, scores, nivo unlock, wind phase)
modules.src/input.js: Slider events (mouse + touch), dugmad click handlers, keyboard shortcuts
modules.src/render.js: Canvas renderer (terrain mapa, zvučni talasi, speaker cones, wind leaves)
modules.src/ui.js: HUD (merači, slideri, dugmadi, level select UI, score board)
modules.src/audio.js: Web Audio: festival ambient, crowd SFX, slider tick, alarm, win jingle, siren
modules.src/systems/acoustics.js: compute_Hs(), compute_Kdb(), compute_angle_atten() — sve akustičke formule
modules.src/systems/wind.js: Wind state machine, sinus oscilator (period 8s, amp ±4 dB), wind indicator data
modules.src/systems/sim.js: Simulation runner: 10s pass timer, real-time meter update, pass/fail dispatch
modules.src/systems/score.js: Score kalkulacija (time + margin bonus), localStorage tiha-avala-scores
modules.src/systems/progression.js: Nivo unlock logic, current level tracking, level-select state
modules.src/levels/level_data.js: 6 nivoa kao data objekti (terrain, neighbours array, constants, hints)
modules.src/content/hints.js: Tutorial tekstovi po nivou, tooltip sadržaj, error poruke
modules.src/content/brand.js: Kluboslavija branding: title, countdown string (39 dana), footer link
modules.src/entities/map.js: Terrain map renderer data: tile tipovi, koordinate, canvas draw primitives
modules.src/entities/speakers.js: Speaker entity: pozicija, angle vizualizacija (konusni crtež), dual-array za L6
modules.src/entities/neighbours.js: Neighbour house entity: pozicija, terrain_path array, trenutni Kdb, boja indikatora
modules.styles/base.css: Layout, canvas centar ekrana, mobile-first responsive
modules.styles/ui.css: Custom sliders (60px visina, 40px thumb), dugmadi, merači, HUD
modules.styles/game.css: Zvučni talas @keyframes, wind leaf animacija, pixel art canvas wrapper
modules.styles/theme.css: Kluboslavija brand: tamno zelena, amber bina, crveno upozorenje, tipografija
